subject: ddl: separate `sessionctx.Context` in  `backfillCtx` to sub-contexts (#53671)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) focusing on DDL backfill/add-index/update-column/partition reorg paths. The refactor extracts per-worker sub-contexts (`exprCtx`, `tblCtx`, `loc`, `WarnHandlerExt`) from a freshly initialized reorg sessCtx and switches txn/snapshot store usage to `ddlCtx.store`; timezone and error/warn handling remain consistent (StmtCtx.TimeZone == EvalCtx.Location; ErrCtx/HandleError semantics preserved), and BatchCheck is set via table ctx so `Index.Create` observes it. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL state/metadata handling.
